notes:
Build the debug APK on every push to main

The repository's default branch is not main, so the "Run workflow"
dropdown offered another one and the APK published to the debug release
was built from a branch without the merge — the plugin was simply not in
it. Trigger on push to main as well, so the asset at the debug release
always matches what main holds. Manual dispatch still works.
